title: transferring-nuclear-dyad-category
description: The category generated by transferring: its objects are Heyting algebras carrying a single transfer nucleus, and its morphisms are the nucleus-preserving Heyting homomorphisms. Each object is the nuclear dyad joining the free carrier to its fixed-point layer by the reflection.

objects.description: an object is a Heyting algebra A equipped with a single transfer nucleus Delta

morphisms.description: a morphism is a Heyting-algebra homomorphism that commutes with the transfer nucleus Delta

nuclearDyad.description: each object is the dyad of the free carrier A and its extension-witnessed fixed-point layer Fix(Delta)

reflection.description: Delta is left adjoint to the inclusion iota (Delta -| iota); A reflects onto Fix(Delta)
